subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 'Launch at login' stops sticking / appears to turn itself off after app updates

question: Should the macOS Launch at login UI reflect persisted user intent across updates, live launchd registration state, or a reconciled combination where persisted intent re-registers launchd after Sparkle replacement?
rationale: The source shows multiple plausible truth sources, and choosing one affects upgrade behavior and what the settings UI should show after update failures.

options.title: Persist intent and reconcile after update
options.body: Store the user’s Launch at login intent and re-register or repair the LaunchAgent after Sparkle updates when intent remains enabled.

options.title: Keep launchd as source of truth
options.body: Treat the live LaunchAgent/login item state as authoritative and adjust the issue toward diagnosing why launchd unregisters during updates.

options.title: Split into diagnostics first
options.body: Add a user-facing diagnostic/doctor path before changing startup behavior so maintainers can collect proof of the exact drift state.

recommendation.title: Persist intent and reconcile after update
recommendation.body: Store the user’s Launch at login intent and re-register or repair the LaunchAgent after Sparkle updates when intent remains enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is the clearest current-history candidate for the Launch at login helper and the startup reconciliation boundary.
